summary: Iteration 3 tested new public hostel listing (/hostels) and detail (/hostels/:id) pages plus backend public endpoints. Backend 21/22 (95.5%) — 1 minor bug: malformed hostel_id returns 500 instead of 404. Frontend 100% — all listed behaviours verified end-to-end (listing header, 3 cards, filter pills, sort, facilities, View Details nav, detail hero/rooms/facilities, enquiry form submission, homepage 'Browse Our Hostels' -> /hostels). All previously working features remain intact.

minor.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error when hostel_id is a malformed ObjectId (e.g. 'not-a-valid-id'). Caused by unhandled bson.errors.InvalidId in ObjectId(hostel_id). Should return 400 or 404. Wrap ObjectId() in try/except in /app/backend/routes/hostel_routes.py get_hostel_public (line 109).

action_items: Fix GET /api/hostels/public/{hostel_id} to return 400/404 (not 500) for malformed ObjectId. Wrap ObjectId(hostel_id) in try/except InvalidId in hostel_routes.py:109.
critical_code_review_comments: hostel_routes.py get_hostel_public: ObjectId(hostel_id) is not wrapped in try/except — malformed IDs crash with 500 instead of returning 404. Same issue likely applies to other endpoints that accept ObjectId path params (get_hostel line 210, update_hostel line 254, delete_hostel line 269).
hostel_routes.py: The random-seeded average_rating/review_count logic is duplicated verbatim between /public and /public/:id. Extract to a helper to keep them consistent and DRY.

hostel_routes.py list_hostels_public: N+1 query pattern (per-hostel: count rooms + count beds x2 + find rooms). Fine for 3 seeded hostels but will not scale; consider aggregate pipeline if hostel count grows.
HostelListingPage.js: uses .filter().sort() on every render which mutates a fresh array — OK, but should be wrapped in useMemo to avoid re-sorting on unrelated state changes (e.g. mobileNav toggle).
HostelDetailPage.js line 63: 'catch { ... }' with no parameter and no logging — errors are swallowed. Add console.error(err) or Sentry-style logging for debugability.

rca_of_the_issue: Backend 500 on malformed ObjectId: bson.ObjectId('not-a-valid-id') raises bson.errors.InvalidId which is not caught, propagates to FastAPI as unhandled 500. Fix: wrap in try/except InvalidId and raise HTTPException(404). Reproduction: curl https://rent-track-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/api/hostels/public/not-a-valid-id -> 500. Same class of bug likely in authenticated /api/hostels/{id}, PUT, DELETE endpoints — recommend introducing a shared parse_object_id() helper.
